description: Header file defining the MPEG4Writer class for media file writing, including methods for writing boxes, handling media tracks, and managing file structure in an Android media framework context.

classes.name: MPEG4Writer
classes.description: Main class for writing MPEG4 media files, managing media tracks, file structure, and encoding details.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source (audio/video/metadata) to the writer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the media writing process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media writing process.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the media writing process.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state for debugging.

methods.name: beginBox
methods.description: Starts a new box in the media file structure.

methods.name: writeInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit integer to the file.

methods.name: writeInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit integer to the file.

methods.name: writeInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer to the file.

methods.name: writeInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer to the file.

methods.name: writeCString
methods.description: Writes a C-style string.

methods.name: writeFourcc
methods.description: Writes a four-character code.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes raw data to the file.

methods.name: endBox
methods.description: Ends the current box.

methods.name: setInterleaveDuration
methods.description: Sets the interleave duration for media chunks.

methods.name: setGeoData
methods.description: Sets geographic metadata.

methods.name: setCaptureRate
methods.description: Sets the capture frame rate.

methods.name: setTemporalLayerCount
methods.description: Sets the number of temporal layers.

methods.name: setStartTimeOffsetMs
methods.description: Sets start time offset in milliseconds.

methods.name: setNextFd
methods.description: Sets the next file descriptor for output.
